draft_question: Documentation of intradialytic hypotension event is incomplete. The treatment note documents recognition of the blood pressure drop and dizziness, as well as a corrective action (reduction of ultrafiltration rate). However, the notes are silent on whether the patient's status was reassessed following the corrective action, and do not document whether the physician was notified. The follow-up note states only that the "patient monitored for the remainder of treatment" without recording the results of that monitoring or any reassessment findings. Please review whether the reassessment and physician notification points are adequately supported by clinical documentation not presented here, or whether they represent gaps in the treatment record.
